body:
MAINLINE-018b checked: 72/75 numeric comparisons reproduce. EUCASS gives linear/nonlinear-perfect/imperfect pressures 27.53/12.45/6.03 MPa flat and 27.56/12.44/5.63 dimple; Sim journal corroborates the linear/imperfect pairs. H80/H35 shear 27/12 MPa and compression modulus 90/40 MPa match the 2012 average-data sheet.

The same unequal-face omission found in 018 changes three dimple fields: sigma0=19,113,852,932.306 Pa, Vc=197.187580270942, classical pressure=767.549432149391 MPa. Crimp pressure and gamma are unchanged. At Gc=20 MPa, gamma is 1.539972862054 flat and 1.446377302132 dimple; at 27 MPa, 1.140720638559 and 1.071390594172.

Own-face-bending fractions 0.004723195064743 and 0.004538262400473 reproduce. They measure facings-only rigidity, not the isolated effect on collapse pressure. H80/H35 rows are denominator-only sensitivities, not new collapse simulations.

Lead-least-times-gamma products reproduce but are not all-mode least factors: unchanged wrinkling limits any uncapped crimp increase to 0.650414127459. With the declared cap, the carry remains 0.650411843681.

These high-Vc numerical cases do not calibrate the continuous optimistic curve or test its moderate-Vc segment. Correction and interpretation limits are in NFI. QUESTIONABLE/PROJECTION; no certification. Assigned check complete.
